create_TileSet: create a TileSet dataclass for tiling configuration of decomposable block diagonal matrices
create_BlockDim: create a BlockDim dataclass with block dimension settings for wp.launch_tiled operations
build_DataWarp: build a DataWarp PyTreeNode containing derived simulation data fields for JAX-based physics computation
build_ModelWarp: build a ModelWarp PyTreeNode containing derived model structure fields for JAX-based physics computation
register_DataWarp_batching: register DataWarp with JAX batching via batching.register_vmappable for vmap-compatible operations
